audit.summary: Archived assessment: Minor. Algorithm exclusion depends on an unvalidated decoder; Direction and family of layer tests need specification; Environmental quantities change workload and accounting scope.
limitations: P1 — Algorithm exclusion depends on an unvalidated decoder — Strongest counterreading: Authors explicitly assume correspondence, use tentative wording, and call for causal tests
P2 — Direction and family of layer tests need specification — Strongest counterreading: Separate prespecified directional families might support each list separately; original analysis design unknown

P3 — Environmental quantities change workload and accounting scope — Strongest counterreading: Interaction could mean extended session; difficult workloads could be larger; near-two-thirds not logically disproved by more-than-half wording
